correctness.rationale: Each exact Gram entry follows from conditional symbol and binomial counts. The two nonstandard interlacing identities are reconstructed as exact rational identities and checked against directly constructed Fourier-character matrices. Inclusion of the weight-zero and weight-one points proves strict positivity; including the complement high-weight points proves upper<1. Standard binomial local/central limit theorems give fixed-q Gaussian outliers.
